name: Blinko
description: Blinko is a self-hosted, open-source AI note-taking tool. Short "blinkos" capture quick ideas and longer notes hold the rest, all in Markdown with tags and todos. With an AI provider such as OpenAI, Anthropic or Ollama it adds RAG search and a chat over your notes.

notes.text: There is no default account: the first sign-up becomes the administrator and closes sign-up. Anyone who reaches the port can claim it, so create it right after the install.
AI search, chat and tagging stay off until you add a model provider under Settings > AI.
